_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-78b. Fully mechanical, and the strongest form in this batch: postSummaryOnClean: false on a deliberately clean diff means no summary comment, no inline comments and no formal Review event, while the check still reports its passing conclusion. The failure this catches is the setting silently suppressing the CHECK too, which would remove the only remaining signal. The flip-to-true half needs a push and stays manual. (fixtures#1076 suggested mustContain 'All clear' — that is the flipped case; here the all-clear must be ABSENT.)
